name: gstack
description: Garry Tan's gstack skill suite (MIT) imported as skill documents only. gstack's own ./setup installs globally under ~/.claude and needs Bun; that part is intentionally not done.

sources.name: gstack
sources.note: 57 SKILL.md folders; helper binaries under bin/ are not installed (global by design)

notes: If you want the full gstack runtime, run its ./setup yourself outside the sandbox; it writes to ~/.claude (global).
